lines.en: I do not walk. I drift.
I slide along the wall like a brick.

lines.zh: 壳底摩擦紫珀，声音很轻。
lines.en: My shell scrapes purpur. The sound is faint.
An inch at a time. Hurry is useless.
From this wall to that one, drifting.
My square shell scrapes the corner, half an inch at a time.

lines.zh: 末地的风推我，我顺着走。
lines.en: The End wind pushes. I go with it.
It looks like motion. It is very slow.
A full circle around the tower's outer wall.
Footsteps? I have no feet.

lines.zh: 从高处落下去，也没声音。
lines.en: Falling from height makes no sound.
Another corner. That one is darker.

lines.zh: 合上壳，我就是一块紫珀。
lines.en: Shell closed, I am a block of purpur.
Do not count me. I am decoration.
Waiting for one set of footsteps to come near.

lines.zh: 末地城很安静，除了风声。
lines.en: The city is quiet, save the wind.
An echo in my shell. It sounds like whispering.
I have hung here for centuries.

lines.zh: 紫珀的纹路，和我壳上很像。
lines.en: The purpur grain matches my shell.
Breathing? I have no need.

lines.zh: 走廊尽头的光，我不去看。
lines.en: Light at the hall's end. I do not look.

lines.zh: 有只末影螨在我下面爬。
lines.en: An endermite crawls beneath me.

lines.zh: 我的耐心比这座城还长。
lines.en: My patience outlasts this city.
Crack the shell. Peek outside.
You have stood below me a long while.
You thought that was purpur?
I am watching from my shell. Look up.
Your boots are loud on the stone.
I have no face, yet I watch you.
You walked in through that door yourself.
This city does not welcome the living.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛在到处找出口。
lines.en: Your eyes are hunting for an exit.

lines.zh: 壳缝里透出的光是紫色的。
lines.en: The light through my seam is violet.

lines.zh: 你数过墙上有多少块砖吗？
lines.en: Have you counted the bricks on this wall?
One of them opens its eye.
Do not come closer. My shell opens.
You tremble. The floor does too.

lines.zh: 我认得你手里的末地石。
lines.en: I know the end stone in your hand.
A crack in my shell.
You hit the soft part.

lines.zh: 这一下，把我挪到了别处。
lines.en: That blow sent me elsewhere.
The sound of cracking shell is ugly.

lines.zh: 我缩回去了，你也别得意。
lines.en: I pulled in. Do not gloat.
Pain? There is no such thing inside.

lines.zh: 你砍到的是紫珀，不是我。
lines.en: You struck purpur, not me.
Hit me again and I change corners.
My shell mends itself.

lines.zh: 你听见的那声，是我在忍。
lines.en: That sound was me enduring it.
What are you holding up? I cannot see it.
I do not eat. I wait.

lines.zh: 紫珀块对我没用，那是墙。
lines.en: Purpur means nothing to me. It is wall.
Trying to make me open? Keep waiting.

lines.zh: 你的火把在末地也会灭。
lines.en: Your torch will die here too.
Put the bait directly below me.

lines.zh: 我不会为任何东西移动。
lines.en: I move for nothing.

lines.zh: 你手里的珍珠，我见过太多。
lines.en: Pearls in your hand. I have seen many.
Stop waving it. It hums in my shell.
Take it away. I am not interested.
Bump me? You bumped a wall.
The shell is hard. Your shoulder gives first.
You press close. I clamp tighter.

lines.zh: 别挤，这块地方是祖传的。
lines.en: Do not crowd. This spot is inherited.

lines.zh: 撞一下，紫珀碎屑掉下来。
lines.en: A knock, and purpur dust falls.
My shell stays. You are the one moving.

lines.zh: 你从上面跳下来，落在我壳上。
lines.en: You dropped from above onto my shell.
No bounce. Only silence.
Too close, and the seam opens.
Move. I shift half a block.

lines.zh: 这座城里，同类互不相认。
lines.en: In this city, kin do not greet kin.

lines.zh: 我们从不并肩，只各占一角。
lines.en: We never stand together, only hold corners.

lines.zh: 没有幼体，只有更多的壳。
lines.en: No young. Only more shells.
Whoever comes close opens first.

lines.zh: 我听过别处壳里的低语，仅此而已。
lines.en: I have heard whispers from other shells. That is all.
Solitude is the End's rule.

lines.zh: 同一面墙上，我们互不搭理。
lines.en: On one wall, we ignore each other.

lines.zh: 繁殖？我们只是越来越多。
lines.en: Breed? We simply become more.

lines.zh: 我的同类在另一座塔上。
lines.en: My kind are in another tower.

lines.zh: 安静，别让两个壳同时打开。
lines.en: Quiet. Never let two shells open at once.

lines.zh: 我没有手，也不需要口袋。
lines.en: I have no hands and no need for pockets.

lines.zh: 掉在城里的东西，会留很久。
lines.en: What falls here stays a long time.

lines.zh: 你的剑落在我壳下，我压着。
lines.en: Your sword fell under me. I rest on it.

lines.zh: 紫珀碎片？那是我的碎屑。
lines.en: Purpur shards? Those are my own dust.
I do not pick things up. I wait for them to be forgotten.
My shell holds only me.
Something rolled in. I did not move.

lines.zh: 末影珍珠在地上跳，真吵。
lines.en: An ender pearl bounces. How noisy.

lines.zh: 这块砖压着你的战利品。
lines.en: This block sits on your spoils.
Take it. Do not leave it in my corner.
Something living entered the hall.
You stepped on my shadow.
Close enough. The shell can open.

lines.zh: 先锁住那个走得最慢的。
lines.en: Lock on to the slowest one.
End stone crunches under you.
You hunt chests. I hunt you.
The archer goes first.

lines.zh: 这座塔的每一层都归我。
lines.en: Every floor of this tower is mine.

lines.zh: 你身上有主世界的味道。
lines.en: That smell on you. You came from the Overworld.
Open a seam and aim.
Do not run. There is one corridor.

lines.zh: 你听见的那声轻响，是我。
lines.en: That soft click you heard was me.
Shell open. The trajectory is set.
You go left. My shot goes left.
The bullet follows. Running is pointless.
Look up. It comes from above.

lines.zh: 我的弹不需要瞄准第二次。
lines.en: My shot needs no second aim.

lines.zh: 你躲在柱子后，我就换角度。
lines.en: Hide behind the pillar. I change angle.
Float up a little. Better line of sight.

lines.zh: 你的披风在动，暴露了位置。
lines.en: Your cloak moves. It gives you away.

lines.zh: 再等一秒，让它自己找路。
lines.en: One more second. Let it find its way.
A violet flash. Time to dodge.
I need not chase. I only need to watch.
Lower. A little lower.

lines.zh: 你退到门口，正好在射程里。
lines.en: You back to the door. Perfect range.
Hit. You will float.
This one lifts you three feet.
Do not grab the wall. It will not hold.

lines.zh: 飘着的时候，你最好别动。
lines.en: While floating, best stay still.

lines.zh: 壳一开一合，弹就出去了。
lines.en: The shell opens and shuts. The shot is gone.
You are in the air. I am where I was.
Before you land, I have another.

lines.zh: 打不穿甲，但能让你失重。
lines.en: It will not pierce armor, but it ends your weight.

lines.zh: 这一下，是替你按的门铃。
lines.en: That was me ringing your doorbell.
Do not hope to hide on the ceiling.
You look clumsy up there.

lines.zh: 弹打空了？那就再开一次壳。
lines.en: Missed? Then the shell opens again.

lines.zh: 末地城建成时，我就在墙里。
lines.en: When the city was built, I was in the wall.
I separate myself from the purpur.

lines.zh: 第一次睁眼，看见的是虚空。
lines.en: My first sight was the void.
This tower needs a keeper.
I press to the wall and play brick.

lines.zh: 外面的岛屿很远，风很干。
lines.en: The outer islands are far. The wind is dry.
No sun. Only violet light.
My shell is new and still brittle.

lines.zh: 有人把我放在了这一层。
lines.en: Someone placed me on this floor.

lines.zh: 末地船停在旁边，桅杆很高。
lines.en: An End ship moors nearby, masts high.

lines.zh: 我不记得自己怎么来的。
lines.en: I do not recall arriving.
First task: find a wall.

lines.zh: 从今天起，这里不许通行。
lines.en: From today, this passage is closed.

lines.zh: 末地没有火，这火把很刺眼。
lines.en: No fire belongs here. Your torch is glaring.
I fall. My shell lands first.
Water? The End has none. Where did this come from?
The blast wave rocks my shell.
An arrow lodged in my seam. Annoying.

lines.zh: 紫光缠上来，和末地的不一样。
lines.en: Violet light clings. Not the End's kind.
I do not eat. What is hunger?

lines.zh: 天上落了雷，这里不该有。
lines.en: Lightning fell. It does not belong here.
The void is outside. I am inside.
